diagram.content: flowchart TD; subgraph Initialization; A --> B(init_psi_random: Generate Random ψ(G)); B --> C(orthogonalize_psi: Initial Orthogonalization); end; subgraph SCF_Loop; C --> D(ifft_psi_batch: ψ(G) → ψ(r)); D --> E(sum_orbitals_sq_local: Compute ρ_local(r)); E --> F(mpi_allreduce_density: Sum to get ρ_total(r)); subgraph Build Potential V_eff(r); F --> G(fft_density: ρ(r) → ρ(G)); G --> H(calc_hartree_pot_g: V_H(G) = 4π/|G|² ρ(G)); H --> I(ifft_hartree_pot: V_H(G) → V_H(r)); F --> J(calc_xc_pot_r: V_xc(r) from ρ(r)); I & J --> K(assemble_potential: V_eff(r) = V_H + V_xc + V_local); end; subgraph Apply Hamiltonian Hψ; K & D --> L(apply_H_realspace: V_eff(r) * ψ(r)); L --> M(fft_H_psi_batch: Real-space part → G-space); C --> N(apply_H_gspace: Add Kinetic Energy Tψ(G)); C --> O(apply_nonlocal_pseudo: Apply V_NL); M & N & O --> P(assemble_H_psi: Hψ(G) = Tψ + V_NLψ + FFT(Vψ)); end; subgraph Update and Orthogonalize; P & C --> Q(eigensolver_step: Update ψ(G) using Hψ); Q --> R(orthogonalize_psi: Enforce Orthonormality); end; subgraph Convergence Check and Mixing; R --> S(calc_energy_and_check_convergence: Calculate E_total, check |ΔE|); S -- No --> T(mix_density: ρ_in ← mix(ρ_in, ρ_out)); T --> F; S -- Yes --> U[End]; end; R --> C_loop_end{{Next Iteration}}; C_loop_end --> C; end;

graph.label: Generate Random Wavefunctions
graph.description: Initialize ψn(G) with random complex numbers for all N_e orbitals.

graph.label: Initial Orthogonalization
graph.description: Enforce orthonormality on the initial random wavefunctions.

graph.label: IFFT Wavefunctions
graph.description: Batch inverse FFT from G-space to real-space: ψn(G) -> ψn(r).

graph.label: Compute Local Density
graph.description: On each MPI rank, compute ρ_local(r) = Σ|ψn(r)|² for local orbitals.

graph.label: MPI Allreduce Density
graph.description: Sum partial densities from all ranks to get total density ρ(r).

graph.label: Mix Density
graph.description: Mix input and output densities for next iteration using Pulay/Broyden scheme.

graph.label: FFT Density
graph.description: Forward FFT of total density: ρ(r) -> ρ(G).

graph.label: Calculate Hartree Potential (G-space)
graph.description: V_H(G) = 4π/|G|² * ρ(G).

graph.label: IFFT Hartree Potential
graph.description: Inverse FFT: V_H(G) -> V_H(r).

graph.label: Calculate XC Potential (R-space)
graph.description: V_xc(r) = δExc/δρ. Depends on ρ(r) and |∇ρ(r)|.

graph.label: Assemble Effective Potential
graph.description: V_eff(r) = V_H(r) + V_xc(r) + V_local(r).

graph.label: Apply Real-Space Hamiltonian
graph.description: Calculate V_eff(r) * ψn(r) for all N_e orbitals.

graph.label: FFT Vψ Batch
graph.description: Forward FFT of Vψ products: (Vψ)n(r) -> (Vψ)n(G).

graph.label: Apply G-Space Hamiltonian (Kinetic)
graph.description: Add kinetic energy term: Tψn(G) = (1/2)|G|² * ψn(G).

graph.label: Apply Non-Local Pseudopotential
graph.description: Apply V_NL via matrix multiplications.

graph.label: Assemble Hψ
graph.description: Sum all Hamiltonian components: Hψ = Tψ + V_NLψ + Vψ.

graph.label: Eigensolver Step
graph.description: Update wavefunctions using an iterative eigensolver (e.g., Davidson, CG).

graph.label: Iterative Orthogonalization
graph.description: Re-orthogonalize the updated wavefunctions.

graph.label: Check Convergence
graph.description: Calculate total energy and check if |ΔE| < threshold.

graph.label: End
graph.description: SCF converged, calculation finished.
